answer: The canyon escrow holds each stake, the comet settlement releases it, and the whisper audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 8% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 155 keys therefore pays that exposure 155 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. That is 35 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
